Sample.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/4] Six participants identified as female, 10 as male and one genderqueer.

Country.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/4] While the focus of the study was experiences in England, some participants had migrated to England from a wide variety of countries; therefore, the sample represented an international perspective in terms of early influences.

Population.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/3] The average age at which participants indicated they made their first suicide attempt was 17.6 years (SD = 3.4 years; range 11–24 years).

Type.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/3] Participants were aged between 26 and 52 years at the time of interview.
